newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends higher export sales, positioning.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends higher export sales, positioning.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended higher Thursday, boosted by USDA weekly export sales data which came in above trade expectation, traders said.
"Export sales were pretty decent," a trader said. "We're seeing a little uptick in business. We're beginning to see some business in new crop."
USDA on Thursday put weekly export sales at 27,800 tonnes, up 93 percent from the previous week.
Rice also rose on positioning ahead of Friday's USDA supply and demand report which will include a new crop production estimate.
"Those numbers tomorrow are going to be pretty important," one floor sources said. "It's our first snapshot of what kind of crop we'll be working with."
Rice ended 19 to 14 cents higher with September up 16-1/2 at $9.20-1/2 per cwt.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 600 lots against Wednesday's actual volume of 651.
